messages.author: ccc2e09d8ea6549a
messages.subject: Can't save wav file
parts:
Hello, 

I'm trying to save wave object into a file. My code is something like that:

savewav(chunk, f=44100, filename='sssss.wav')

where chunk is instance of class Wave

And I'm getting error:

tuneR >= 1.0 has changed its Wave class definition.
Use updateWave(object) to convert Wave objects saved with previous versions of tuneR.
Error in length(object) : could not find function "loadMethod"
Calls: writeWave -> length
Execution halted

I've investigated this a bit more, and found that function savewav calls writeWave from tuneR.

But even examp from the manual for tuneR does not work

library(tuneR)
Wobj <- sine(440)
tdir <- tempdir()
tfile <- file.path(tdir, "myWave.wav")
writeWave(Wobj, filename = tfile)

Results

tuneR >= 1.0 has changed its Wave class definition.
Use updateWave(object) to convert Wave objects saved with previous versions of tuneR.
Error in length(object) : could not find function "loadMethod"
Calls: writeWave -> length
Execution halted

Few things more:
- It doesn't work from console as Rscript
- But it works from R-studio (with the same library pathes)

I'll appreciate any help on this issue

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Can't save wav file
parts:
Hello,

You may need to update your version of seewave. The last one should fix the problem.

Best regards,

Jerome

messages.author: 25cfc7ef337dd374
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Can't save wav file
parts:
Solved. It works when executed as 

/usr/lib/R/bin/R --slave --no-restore --vanilla --file=file.R

instead of

Rscript  file.R
